messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions and find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. I'm not seeing any active prescriptions on file for you at Brightway 4471. It's possible they haven't been transferred to our system yet, or they may have been filled recently and the records haven't synced. Which Harbor location on Main were you thinking of—the one downtown at 120 Main, the one near the university at 2250 Main, or the one in Northgate Mall?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores]
CALLER: Near Oak, that's the one by my apartment.
AGENT: Perfect, that's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main. Since your prescriptions aren't showing in our system yet, I'll need to request the transfer from Brightway. Can you confirm the prescription details—do you have the Rx numbers, or can you tell me the medication strengths for the albuterol and sertraline?
CALLER: Wait, near Oak is by University? I thought that was more like a different part of town, but okay if you say so. I don't got the Rx numbers on me, just know it's albuterol and sertraline, standard stuff.
AGENT (LATEST): You're right to double-check—let me make sure we have the right store. The one near Oak Street is at 2250 Main St University, which is in the university area of Lakeview. Does that sound like it's near your apartment, or would one of the other locations work better for you?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
move_2: the agent asks him to look up the address
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Does not know the address"
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered store options earlier, not asking without options"}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask caller to look up an address"}, "asked_3": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks if it's near his apartment, addressing address knowledge"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No transfer confirmation with address has occurred"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
